# Validation results (generated — do not edit by hand)

Generated by `paper_v2/scripts/make_validation_section.py` from the JSON files in `paper_v2/output/`.

## 1. Human validation of the judge labels

- Sample: 216 of the 900 Qwen3.8-27B outputs (EN-MATCH, CS-LAT, MIXED × 128/512/1,024 tokens), stratified within each budget × condition cell by judge-agreement pattern; inverse-probability weights make the estimates describe all 900 outputs.
- 5 fluent readers (CSE students), 405 labels; reviewers saw question, gold and answer only (no condition, budget or judge label).
- Double-labelled items: 189; binary agreement 0.93; Cohen's κ = 0.85 (primary collapse), 0.90 (secondary).
- Disagreements: 14; adjudicated 14; unresolved items (0) are excluded from the estimates below.
- Bengali has one reader only, so no Bengali agreement figure.

| Language | Double-labelled | Agreement | κ |
|---|---|---|---|
| English | 72 | 0.90 | 0.80 |
| Hindi | 30 | 0.93 | 0.86 |
| Kannada | 32 | 0.91 | 0.80 |
| Tamil | 28 | 1.00 | 1.00 |
| Telugu | 27 | 0.93 | 0.85 |
